Package modelCheckCTL.model

Class ModelChecker

java.lang.Object
modelCheckCTL.model.ModelChecker
public final class ModelChecker extends Object
Explicit-state set-based CTL evaluation using least/greatest fixed points.

  • Method Details

    • satisfyingStates

      public Set<String> satisfyingStates(Formula f)
      Evaluates an expression and returns all states satisfying it. Results are cached by expression-node identity, and the model's state order is retained for predictable output.
      Parameters:
      f - parsed CTL expression
      Returns:
      unmodifiable set of satisfying state IDs

    • least

      private Set<String> least(Set<String> seed, Set<String> restriction, boolean universal)
      Computes a least fixed point for EF, AF, EU, and AU. Starting from the seed set, repeatedly adds eligible predecessors until stable.
      Parameters:
      seed - states where the eventual or right-hand condition already holds
      restriction - states where the left-hand until condition holds, or null
      universal - whether all immediate successors must satisfy the current set
      Returns:
      the least stable set containing the seed

    • greatest

      private Set<String> greatest(Set<String> seed, boolean universal)
      Computes a greatest fixed point for EG and AG by repeatedly removing states that fail the relevant predecessor condition. Terminal-state handling follows the supplied course fixture expectations.
      Parameters:
      seed - states satisfying the globally required subformula
      universal - whether to use the universal predecessor relation
      Returns:
      greatest stable subset of the seed
